name: Buddy
bio: Buddy is a ball of sunshine who never met a stranger. He loves nothing more than a good morning run followed by a nap in a sunny spot. Great with kids and other dogs, Buddy is house-trained and knows basic commands. He was found wandering near a highway and has been with us for two months — he's more than ready to find his forever home.

name: Luna
bio: Luna is an adventurer at heart. She's got striking blue eyes and endless energy — perfect for someone who loves the outdoors. She's been our best running partner and absolutely lights up on the trail. Luna is working on her leash manners but is making amazing progress. She'd do best as the only pet in the home.

name: Tank
bio: Don't let the name fool you — Tank is a 65-pound lap dog. He's gentle, goofy, and gives the best hugs. Tank was surrendered by his previous family when they moved and couldn't take him along. He's fully house-trained, crate-trained, and walks beautifully on a leash. Tank loves short jogs and long belly rub sessions equally.

name: Pepper
bio: Pepper was a whirlwind of energy and smarts. This Border Collie mix could learn a trick in minutes and run for miles without breaking a sweat. She found her perfect match with a family that takes her hiking every weekend. Happy trails, Pepper!
